newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to announce new deregulation package.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to announce new deregulation package.

text.p: Indonesia will announce a new package of economic deregulation measures within a few months, Coordinating Minister for Production and Distribution Hartarto said on Wednesday.

"We will continue deregulation and de-bureacratisation," Hartarto told business leaders from Southeast Asia and its trading partners. "We are going to announce another package in the next coming few months."
Indonesia's last major economic reform package was in June last year, when it cut import tariffs on 1,497 items, simplified trade procedures and offered incentives for export-oriented firms.
President Suharto said in December that reforms on the way included simplifying licence and customs procedures and creating a consistent business climate.
He also ordered officials to continue privatising state firms.
